methods.name: Quest skip to level 33
methods.note: The Tourist Trap with both rewards on Agility reaches 26; Recruitment Drive, Depths of Despair and The Grand Tree make 19,700 XP, level 33. Death on the Isle adds 7,500.

methods.name: Rooftop courses
methods.note: Draynor, Al Kharid, Varrock, Falador, Seers, Pollnivneach, Rellekka, then Ardougne at 90, with no diaries. Canifis at 40 is faster but needs Priest in Peril.

methods.name: Brimhaven Arena floor spikes
methods.note: Jump the floor spikes by the entrance back and forth, 24 XP every 4 ticks. It costs 200 coins to enter, and below 50 you fail now and then, so bring food.

methods.name: Agility Pyramid
methods.note: Each pyramid top sells to Simon Templeton for 10,000 coins. Falls drop you a level until 75, where 26 laps an hour is the most.

methods.name: Brimhaven Arena ticket pillars
methods.note: Tag the marked dispenser each minute for XP and a ticket worth 345 XP, and jump the floor spikes in between. Karamja gloves 2 add 10 percent.

methods.name: Colossal Wyrm course
methods.note: Varlamore course with long obstacles that cannot be failed and few clicks, advanced route at 62. Termites buy amylase, bone shards give Prayer XP.

methods.name: Hallowed Sepulchre
methods.note: Floors open at 52, 62, 72, 77 and 87, boostable. Rates loot no coffin and assume practice and a private instance, which costs 200 hallowed marks; bring staminas.

methods.name: Wilderness Agility Course
methods.note: Deep Wilderness with player killers, so risk little. Tag the dispenser each lap for a ticket worth 230 XP when 101 go in at once; obstacles can fail at any level.

methods.name: Seers' rooftop with Camelot teleport
methods.note: The hard Kandarin Diary moves Camelot Teleport next to the course start, so teleport after every lap. You stop failing at 79.

methods.name: Werewolf Agility Course
methods.note: Needs the Ring of Charos from the quest. The death slide stops failing at 80 Agility and 80 Strength under 2 kg, which the 80 band assumes.

methods.name: Pollnivneach rooftop with hard diary
methods.note: The hard Desert Diary raises the drying line to 666 XP and speeds up marks of grace. You stop failing at 85.

methods.name: Hallowed Sepulchre looting coffins
methods.note: Loot the worthwhile coffins from floor 3 for hallowed marks, bringing planks, nails, vampyre dust and cosmic runes. The Grand Coffin needs 84 Thieving or 92 Agility.

methods.name: Prifddinas Agility Course
methods.note: Rooftop-style course in Prifddinas; you stop failing at 91. Portals give about 45 crystal shards an hour instead of marks of grace.

methods.name: Rellekka rooftop with hard diary
methods.note: The hard Fremennik Diary raises the pile of fish to 615 XP and speeds up marks of grace. You stop failing at 85.

unverified: Quest skip to level 33: The Tourist Trap (2 x 4,650; 10 Fletching, 20 Smithing), Recruitment Drive (1,000.5), The Depths of Despair (1,500; 18 Agility) and The Grand Tree (7,900; 25 Agility) give 19,700.5 XP, level 33; Death on the Isle (7,500; 32 Agility, 34 Thieving, Children of the Sun) brings it to 36, as the Ironman Guide says; one-off XP, so never dealt

Rooftop courses: 85% of each course's perfect lap (XP a lap over the seconds a lap on its page), which agree with Jagex's own table of 8 May 2024 within 1%; the guide's no-diary ranges sit at 85 to 100% of the same maxima; failing slows the first levels of Seers' (to 79), Pollnivneach and Rellekka (to 85) and Ardougne (to 95); Canifis (40; 240 XP a 43.8 s lap, 16,800 at 85%) is out of the bands because it needs Priest in Peril, which req cannot ask of one band

Brimhaven Arena floor spikes: 85% of the guide's up to 30,000 from 20, where you still fail, and of 36,000 from 50 (24 XP every 4 ticks); Karamja gloves 2 make a crossing 26.4 XP; single-clicking one tile is low attention but a click every 2.4 seconds

Agility Pyramid: no rate exists below 75 but the guide's about 13 laps and 25,000 for 30 to 50 and the page's player samples (25,000 to 30,000 at 55 to 60; 33,000 to 37,000 at 67 to 70, held to 85% of a no-fail hour); from 75, 85% of 26 laps of 722 XP plus the 300 + 8 a level bonus (42,172 at 75, 44,772 from 88; Jagex 44,750)

Brimhaven Arena ticket pillars: 85% of a maximum rebuilt from the arena: 60 tags an hour (30 XP each 10 levels), tickets of 345 XP, and the floor spikes for the 67.6% of the hour that the arena page's up to 68,000 at 99 leaves; a timed hour at 40 gave 47,324 (91% of that maximum, guide edit of 1 February 2025); Karamja gloves 2 (medium Karamja Diary) add 10% and are not counted

Colossal Wyrm course: 85% of the course page's 31,000 (49 laps of 633 XP) and 43,000 (41 laps of 1,053.6), timed in game on 12 August 2026 when the laps were lengthened; the page still carries an obsolete banner and its basic obstacle table adds to 601.6 XP, not 633 (25,800 at 85%); Varlamore needs Children of the Sun

Hallowed Sepulchre: 85% of a maximum rebuilt from the strategy page's tick-perfect floor times (each floor's entrances averaged) and the guide's downtimes: 45,800, 57,900, 73,000, 87,900 and 108,300; the guide's 45,000 to 98,500 are 91 to 98% of those, and the Ultimate Ironman Guide's 39,000 to 85,000 agree within 8%; no coffin is looted, so no Thieving is needed, but the private instance the rates assume costs 200 hallowed marks, which only looting (66 Thieving) gives; Wise Old Man's rows still break at 82 and 92

Wilderness Agility Course: estimated; laps an hour from the obstacles' success charts (rope swing and log 88.7%, stepping stones 84.8% at 52, all 98% at 99) with an assumed 60 ticks lost to a fall into the pit and 8 to a stepping stone, calibrated to the page's 83 laps at high levels; no page times a fall, and falls of 25 to 100 ticks would make 52 anything from 52,200 to 42,000; nothing is counted for player killers; tickets of 230 XP counted; Wise Old Man's 35,000 at 47 to 51 is close to the course XP alone (33,400 at 52)

Seers' rooftop with Camelot teleport: 85% of 570 XP a lap at the course page's about 37 seconds with the teleport (55,459; the page rounds to 56,000); the Agility page says up to 58,900; the hard Kandarin Diary asks 56 Magic, above the spell's 45

Werewolf Agility Course: 85% of the page's tick-perfect 68,600 from 80 (94 laps of 730 XP), which the guide's 67,000 to 68,000 confirms; below 80, 85% of the page's up to 60,000, where the guide says up to 50,000 to 55,000 (44,600 at 85%); the 80 band also needs 80 Strength and under 2 kg, which req cannot ask of one band
Pollnivneach rooftop with hard diary: 85% of 1,016 XP every 101 ticks (60,356; Jagex 60,000)

Hallowed Sepulchre looting coffins: the mean of three practised looting figures (money making guides 58,400, 73,000 and 88,100; Ironman Guide 63,000, 73,000 and 90,000; Wise Old Man ironman 64,000, 72,600 and 89,000) scaled by the no-loot entry's ordinary to practised ratio (0.90, 0.94, 0.93); 66 Thieving opens any coffin; bridges need 56 Construction, braziers 54 Prayer and pillars 62 Ranged; the Grand Coffin needs 84 Thieving or 66 with 92 Agility, which the 87 band assumes

Prifddinas Agility Course: 85% of the course page's table (54,000 at 75 to 66,000 at 90), with 90 at 85% of the guide's tick-perfect 65,481; the guide's up to around 60,000 at 75 is 11% above the page's table
Rellekka rooftop with hard diary: 85% of 920 XP every 85 ticks (64,941; Jagex 65,000)

Not included: Ape Atoll (48, Monkey Madness I half done and a ninja greegree; 55,100 at most from 75, 46,800 at 85%, level with the rooftops); Dorgesh-Kaan (70, Death to the Dorgeshuun; 63,000 for a 2:36 lap without falls, but falls at every level and on no guide); Shayzien advanced (45, a crossbow and mith grapple, 30,000); the Penguin course (30, Cold War and a clockwork suit, 30,000); Barbarian Outpost (35, the Barcrawl, 18,400); Gnome Stronghold (10,000, as Draynor); the Edgeville Dungeon monkey bars (15, Wilderness, 13,200); Barbarian Fishing (Agility as a side effect of Fishing, Wise Old Man ironman's 45 to 73); the Vampyrium rockslide (550 XP every 7.5 minutes, 4,400 an hour beside other things); Underwater Agility and Thieving (38,800 at 99 in both); Wintertodt pillars (21,000); the Blast Furnace belt (6,000)
